## Affected callers
- Kotlin's `get_skeleton` and `get_skeleton_header` call the shared renderer (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/kotlin/mod.rs:729); both receive the constructor-role child filtering in crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/common.rs:276.
- The semantic inventory uses `class_parameter_default` to create an initializer procedure with an expression body (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/kotlin/semantic/inventory.rs:466); that name now reexports the JVM default-expression helper (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/kotlin/semantic/syntax.rs:165).
- The Java conversion route passes written argument count to `formal_layout` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/conversions.rs:170); it first requires one declaration range and one metadata entry (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/conversions.rs:154), then joins conversion facts by argument, site, formal, target and signature (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/conversions.rs:193).
- Call-site relation expansion invokes `bind_call_site_arguments` and stores its status alongside the mutated site (crates/bifrost-rql/src/structural/search/relations.rs:90); the binder now requests a layout for that site's argument count (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/call_relations.rs:2140).
- Written constructors now use source CodeUnits (crates/bifrost-jvm/src/kotlin/declarations.rs:399, crates/bifrost-jvm/src/kotlin/declarations.rs:478); `IndexedDeclarations::get` excludes synthetic units before projecting declarations (crates/bifrost-rql/src/structural/search/mod.rs:847), and dispatch's locator projection applies the same synthetic exclusion (crates/bifrost-rql/src/structural/search/dispatch.rs:298).
- Kotlin's inverted graph calls `bare_callable_unit` for a call with recorded arity (crates/bifrost-jvm/src/kotlin/graph/inverted.rs:694); that lookup now applies the metadata-based constructor exclusion in `ordinary_callable` (crates/bifrost-jvm/src/kotlin/graph/resolver.rs:692).

## Paths
- Dispatch's `retain_artifact_candidates` filters procedure handles by the selected declaration range (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:3689); the remaining handles enter `retain_dispatch_candidate` with the supplied proof, completeness and candidate limit (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/semantic/workspace_oracle/dispatch.rs:3706).
- Kotlin bare-call resolution tries callable scopes with arity and then without arity (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/kotlin.rs:1628), using the constructor-excluding callable lookup (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/kotlin.rs:951); its subsequent type route selects constructor declarations or the class itself (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/get_definition/kotlin.rs:1654).
- The query pipeline passes its shared binding cache and optional semantic context into `call_binding_expansions` (crates/bifrost-rql/src/structural/search/pipeline.rs:2868); after obtaining the argument-count-specific layout (crates/bifrost-rql/src/structural/search/call_binding.rs:773), expansion independently requests dispatch at the call's source range (crates/bifrost-rql/src/structural/search/call_binding.rs:812).

## Value flow
- Kotlin default-expression nodes enter formal slots through `parameter_default_range` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/lexical_definitions.rs:936) and are stored as `default_range` (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/lexical_definitions.rs:199); exhaustive binding emits an unbound, nonvariadic slot's default as a row whose range is that expression and whose argument ID is absent (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/call_binding.rs:564).
- The changed Kotlin epoch salt (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/epoch.rs:1115) feeds `ensure_language_epoch`, which passes the language label and computed epoch into generation reconciliation (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/store/mod.rs:2686).
- `raw_call_site` constructs arguments from syntax and initially leaves formal index and name unset (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/call_relations.rs:2105); their vector length now participates in the formal-layout cache key (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/call_relations.rs:365), and binding writes the selected formal index, name and variadic flag back to each argument (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/call_relations.rs:2159).
- Signature reports enumerate persisted entries and preserve their ordinal (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/callable_signature.rs:152); `signature_choice` returns that ordinal (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/callable_signature.rs:352), which layout selection uses to read the selected entry's arity before comparing AST layouts (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/call_relations.rs:2395).
- Primary constructor metadata records the constructor role (crates/bifrost-jvm/src/kotlin/declarations.rs:422), as does secondary constructor metadata (crates/bifrost-jvm/src/kotlin/declarations.rs:502); the new ordinary-callable predicate reads that role to exclude constructors from member lookup (crates/bifrost-jvm/src/kotlin/graph/resolver.rs:241).
- `receiver_contract_of` derives `Extension` from persisted extension-receiver type metadata (crates/bifrost-analysis/src/analyzer/usages/callable_signature.rs:256); the Kotlin receiver branch consumes that contract (crates/bifrost-rql/src/structural/search/call_binding.rs:1276) and uses the call shape's receiver range, obtained before contract selection (crates/bifrost-rql/src/structural/search/call_binding.rs:1254).
